semantic.name: Primary

semantic.name: Neutral
semantic.purpose: Absolute neutral design scale for flexible site-specific use.
semantic.notes: Neutral 0 through Neutral 100. Does not flip between modes.

semantic.name: Text Muted
semantic.notes: Hard General Text rule: use the weakest Neutral foreground that still clears the 4.5:1 minimum against the actual normal context. Do not strengthen Muted merely to chase 7:1.

semantic.name: Text Subtle
semantic.notes: Hard General Text rule: choose a perceptual middle ground between Muted and Default with meaningful visual distinction from both. Minimum contrast 4.5:1.

semantic.name: Text Default
semantic.purpose: Default body and general UI text.
semantic.notes: Hard General Text rule: main foreground. On a light normal context use Neutral 90 or Neutral 100 (black). Minimum 4.5:1; 7:1 recommended.

semantic.name: Text Inverse Muted
semantic.purpose: Lowest-emphasis general text in inverse contexts.
semantic.notes: Hard General Text inverse rule: use the weakest light-side Neutral foreground that still clears the 4.5:1 minimum against the actual inverse context. Do not strengthen Muted merely to chase 7:1.

semantic.name: Text Inverse Subtle
semantic.purpose: Supporting general text in inverse contexts.
semantic.notes: Hard General Text inverse rule: choose a perceptual middle ground between Inverse Muted and Inverse Default with meaningful visual distinction from both. Minimum contrast 4.5:1.

semantic.name: Text Inverse Default
semantic.purpose: Default general text in inverse contexts.
semantic.notes: Hard General Text inverse rule: main foreground. On a dark/inverse context use Neutral 10 or Neutral 0 (white). Minimum 4.5:1; 7:1 recommended.

semantic.name: Text Primary

semantic.name: Text Primary Strong
